description:
A screenshot utility for capturing, annotating, pinning, and recognizing screen content.


Snow Shot / Snow Shot Mini 1.4.5
- Create PDFs with image and ID-card templates, adjust image spacing, and reverse page order. / PDF 拼图新增多图与证件模板，支持调整图片间距、反转页面顺序。
- Choose smart selection for windows or window elements, or turn it off; add a cancel action to your screenshot controls. / 智能选择可选窗口、窗口子元素或关闭，并可配置取消截图操作。
- Automatically pause global hotkeys for fullscreen games or all fullscreen windows. / 可选择在全屏游戏或所有全屏窗口中自动停用全局快捷键。
- Replace pinned content with standard paste shortcuts and keep pins in the same stacking order after restoring them. / 贴图支持使用标准粘贴快捷键替换内容，恢复后保留原有叠放顺序。
- Improve capture recovery, macOS launch at login, tooltip timing, and settings transfers that preserve your local folders. / 改善截图恢复、macOS 开机启动和工具提示，导入设置时保留本机目录。
Download guide / 下载指南
Snow Shot has all features. Mini is smaller and includes capture, annotation, pinning, stitching, recording, and manual text recognition. / 完整版提供全部功能；Mini 体积更小，保留截图、标注、贴图、拼图、录屏及手动文字识别。

Files ending in -update.zip, .json, .sha256, or -homebrew.tar.gz serve updates, verification, or package managers. / 在线版按需下载 OCR，离线版内含 OCR 组件和默认模型，便携版解压即用；其他文件用于更新、校验或包管理器。
Quick macOS install / macOS 快速安装
Run in Terminal without sudo; append --edition mini for Mini. / 复制到终端运行，无需添加 sudo；末尾添加 --edition mini 可安装 Mini。
curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -o install-snow-shot-macos.sh https://github.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/download/v1.4.5_snow-shot/install-snow-shot-macos.sh && bash install-snow-shot-macos.sh
The installer verifies and locally signs the app. Grant Screen Recording and Accessibility when prompted. For Gitee downloads, replace https://github.com with https://gitee.com in the command and download links. / 安装器会校验并本机签名，请按提示授予屏幕录制及辅助功能权限；使用 Gitee 下载时，将命令及下载链接中的 https://github.com 替换为 https://gitee.com。
